announcements.label.description: The name of the list of the server's announcements, for assistive technology.

announcements.loading.description: What the list of announcements says while the first of them load.

announcements.loading_more.description: What the list of announcements says under them while more load.

announcements.failed.description: What the list of announcements says when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

announcements.failed_more.defaultMessage: More announcements could not be loaded.
announcements.failed_more.description: What the list of announcements says under them when more could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

announcements.empty.defaultMessage: No announcements yet. When the server's administrators post one, it shows here.
announcements.empty.description: What the list of announcements says when the server has made none.

announcements.unread.description: The mark of an announcement the reader has not read, for assistive technology.

announcements.mark_read.description: The action under an unread announcement in the list that marks it read.

announcements.ended.description: Said under an announcement in the list whose showing period is over.

announcements.untitled.description: The title of an announcement whose administrators gave it none.

announcements.period_open.description: Under an announcement on its page: since when it shows ({from}, a date written out in the reader's language), with no end set.

announcements.period_until.description: Under an announcement on its page: when it started to show and when it stops ({from}, {until}, dates written out in the reader's language).

announcements.period_ended.description: Under an announcement on its page whose showing period is over: when it showed ({from}, {until}, dates written out in the reader's language).

announcements.back.description: The button at the top of an announcement's page that goes back to the list of announcements.

announcements.loading_one.description: What an announcement's page says while it loads.

announcements.not_found.defaultMessage: This announcement was not found. It may have been withdrawn.
announcements.not_found.description: What an announcement's page says when the server has no such announcement (never shown, or withdrawn), beside a link to the list.

announcements.all.description: The link after the not-found notice of an announcement's page that opens the list of announcements.
